Title: WHOIS Lookup
Description: Ask one WHOIS server for one name and read the reply from TCP port 43.
Seo_Title: WHOIS lookup from your computer | MyDevTools
Keywords: WHOIS, port 43, domain lookup, local agent, one query
PrivacyShort: The query runs on your computer through the local agent. The name, the server and the reply stay on this page.
PairCodeHint: Paste the current code from the agent window. The field is cleared after each attempt.
ConnectionNotSaved: This browser could not store the connection or the timeout. They last only until you leave the page.
SetupIntro: Download and start the local agent, then come back to this page.
SetupStep2: Start MyDevTools Agent. A private or loopback address needs the agent started with --allow-private.
SetupStep3: Copy the pairing code from the agent window.
SetupStep4: Paste the code below. If the browser asks for local-network access, allow it for this connection.
PrivacyNote: The browser sends the query, the server and the timeout only to the agent on 127.0.0.1. The agent opens one TCP connection to port 43, sends one line, reads the reply and closes. It does not follow a referral to a second server. The check does not go to a MyDevTools server. This browser remembers the timeout. It does not store the query, the server or the reply.
NeedWhoisCapability: This connection cannot query WHOIS yet. Enter a new pairing code to add whois.lookup. Grants this browser already holds stay until that pairing succeeds.
NotConnected: Connect the local agent before a WHOIS query.
QueryHint: One name or handle, up to 255 characters. A second line, a URL and a numeric range are not a query. The agent sends this line once and does not follow a referral.
ServerHint: One WHOIS server host. The agent always uses TCP port 43. Private and loopback addresses need --allow-private.
TimeoutHint: How long to wait for this one query, from 200 to 10000 milliseconds.
StatusUnreachable: There is no route to that address.
StatusTruncated: The answer was cut after 64 KiB.
EmptyResult: Check one name on one WHOIS server to see the reply.
InvalidQuery: Enter one name of 1 to 255 characters, with no second line and no URL.
InvalidServer: Enter one WHOIS server host. A port does not belong in this field.
InvalidTimeout: Enter a timeout from 200 to 10000 milliseconds.
Error_agent_unavailable: The local agent is not running.
Error_invalid_response: The agent returned a response this page cannot read.
Error_invalid_request: That name, server or timeout was rejected.
Error_unauthorized: The pairing code was rejected, or the session expired.
Error_forbidden: This connection is not allowed to query WHOIS.
Error_pairing_invalid: That pairing code is not the current one.
Error_pairing_expired: That pairing code has expired. Copy the new one from the agent.
Error_pairing_rate_limited: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute and try the current code.
Error_unsupported_capability: This agent does not advertise WHOIS. It needs a build that lists whois.lookup.
Error_busy: The agent is already running as many checks as it allows.
Error_network_error: The request to the local agent failed.
Error_incompatible_protocol: This page and the agent use different protocol versions.
Error_not_found: The agent does not have that request.
Error_name_not_found: That name did not resolve. No connection was opened.
Error_private_network_denied: Private and loopback addresses need the agent started with --allow-private.
Error_target_denied: That address is always blocked. Metadata, link-local and multicast addresses cannot be checked.
Error_whois_unavailable: The agent could not finish the WHOIS query.
Seo_Introduction: WHOIS Lookup asks the local agent to open one TCP connection to port 43 on a WHOIS server you name, send one line, and show the reply. The grant is whois.lookup, separate from http.request, icmp.trace, dns.lookup, tcp.connect and tls.inspect.
Seo_DetailedDescription: The agent resolves the server to the first address and applies the same destination rules as TCP connect. Private and loopback addresses work only when the agent was started with --allow-private. The query is one line ending in a carriage return and a line feed. A URL, a second line and a numeric range such as 80-443 are rejected. The reply is kept up to 64 KiB and is not followed when it names another server. At most two queries run at once. The timeout stays in this browser. The name, the server and the reply do not.
Seo_Examples:
- `example.com` on `whois.iana.org` shows the reply text, including a referral line when the registry sends one.
- `127.0.0.1` with nothing listening on port 43 shows a refusal.
- `80-443` is rejected. This is not a scan.
Seo_HowToSteps:
### Step 1: Start the local agent
Download the agent, start it, and copy the pairing code.

### Step 2: Pair WHOIS
Paste the code and connect. The page asks for whois.lookup and keeps capabilities this browser already holds.

### Step 3: Query one name
Enter one name and one WHOIS server, set the timeout, and press Check.

### Step 4: Read the reply
The page shows the status, the address, the time and the text. Copy it. Reloading the page clears the name, the server and the reply.
Seo_Tips:
- A refused connection, a timeout and an empty reply are results. They are not a failed check.
- One request is one name and one server on port 43. A referral inside the text is not followed.
- At most two queries run at once.
- The published Windows download may be older than this page. WHOIS needs an agent that advertises whois.lookup.
